items.quote: They’re not just top performers. They’re internal motivators.
items.statement: Top performers are internal motivators and raise the standard for the entire team.

items.quote: their commission split is not 50/50. It’s higher than you think.
items.statement: The commission split for top sales agents is higher than 50/50.

items.quote: Instead of chasing unicorns, here’s what you should focus on: Hire for potential.
items.statement: Focus on hiring for potential rather than just past sales volume.

items.quote: Train for performance. Build the character — not just the pipeline.
items.statement: Train agents for performance and build character.

items.quote: Top salespeople are not built on ego. They’re built on grit.
items.statement: True top salespeople are built on grit, not ego.

items.quote: the mindset to receive constructive criticism — and actually use it.
items.statement: Candidates should have the mindset to receive constructive criticism and utilize it.

items.quote: If your business can only survive with top closers — you don’t have a real business.
items.statement: Businesses that survive solely with top closers do not possess a real business model.

items.quote: But if you believe you’ve got the character and mindset to become one — I’d love to hear from you.
items.statement: Seek candidates who believe they have the character and mindset to excel in sales.

overview: Observations from a LinkedIn post discussing strategies for attracting high-performing sales agents.
